data.description: Compute-only diagnosis (bug 8b25 chunk12) found a steady-state non-parent re-emitter cluster: local tickets bound (binding_store) to Jira keys NOT present in the fetch_snapshot working set (status=Done outside _DONE_RECENT_CAP window, or deleted in Jira). The outbound differ sees jira_fields={} for these, diffs every field as changed (summary=None vs local), and re-emits summary/description/priority/status updates on every pass. Examples observed: DIG-5328/5329/5332/5335 (detected_by:* bug tickets). Separate from the parent re-emitter (fixed in chunk12). Fix likely needs binding-GC or snapshot-window awareness so a bound-but-absent Jira key does not diff against empty fields. ALSO: pre-existing unit failure test_e2e_dedup_pass.py::test_pre_existing_dso_id_produces_zero_creates fails on HEAD (mapping.json not written by dedup guard; FakeAcliClient lacks get_comments) — independent of chunk12, baseline 792/1/2.
data.title: reconciler: stale bindings to out-of-window/deleted Jira issues cause perpetual field re-emit
